scope: One resettable causal Kalman comparison, not further neural training. Same already inspected development recording
primary: masked_training; original and clean_control reported without best-case selection

filter.measurement: H=[1,0]; frozen TCN ensemble speed only
filter.update: Ordinary linear prediction/correction; Joseph covariance update, symmetrized. Clip output speed at zero only
filter.measurement_noise: Shared R=max(1e-4,(1.4826*median(abs(e-median(e))))^2), e=unchanged original TCN fit prediction minus fit target,16169samples. Do not subtract fitted bias
filter.state_reset: Every source quality rejection, additional postfilter peer rejection, or inter-event gap>100ms. First accepted packet after reset emitted directly without hidden warmup
filter.guard: Original quality acceptance AND absolute filtered speed minus same CNN mean<=1m/s. No previously rejected endpoint becomes accepted

requests: Same20Hz integer grid, latest raw attempt,100ms TTL, no future inference or fallback to an older accepted attempt

gates.scope: Every300s segment including last partial, whole recording and earlier supported90s blocks with >=95% retention

diagnosis: Exploratory diagnosis of known failures motivates one fixed filter. Highly correlated residuals violate an independent white-noise interpretation; no optimality, covariance calibration or physical-bound claim

baseline_reference.title: An Introduction to the Kalman Filter
baseline_reference.scope: General discrete Kalman recursion; state, shared noise rule, reset and rejection policy are this project design. Not a reproduction of a vehicle-specific published method
